# FAQ-005 Engineering FAQ #5

Revision: Rev A

Q: What is the approved lubricant for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1?
A: The lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is CFW-LUB-315. See SOP-P2-L4-03 for application and handling.

Q: What torque should be applied to the mandrel clamp bolts on Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1?
A: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is 525 N·m. Verify using a calibrated torque wrench per MM-P1-L2-RR01.

Q: What torque should be applied to the mandrel clamp bolts on Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1?
A: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 395 N·m. Confirm torque sequence and re-check after initial run-in as outlined in MM-P1-L2-RR01.

Q: What lubricant is specified for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2?
A: The lubricant part number for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is CFW-LUB-195. Refer to SOP-P3-L4-05 for reservoir fill and contamination control.

Q: What alarm setpoint applies to the dust collector for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3?
A: The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 1240 Pa. Troubleshooting and alarm response steps are in SOP-P2-L4-03 and MM-P1-L2-RR01 where applicable.

Related documents: MM-P1-L2-RR01, SOP-P2-L4-03, SOP-P3-L4-05.
